payload.title: Image toolchain step 2: Style profile in the backend
payload.description:
Build step 2 of the image toolchain (design: project/wiki/image-toolchain.md, section 9).

`visual-style` doctrine kind, `metadata.visualStyle` and `metadata.imageReview` schemas, `resolve_visual_style`, constraints, `NewsroomSection.visualStyle` field, `image-service` Lambda with `imageRead`/`imageWrite` and the profile operations, `papyrus images profile ...`, editorial-context `visual-style` entry, context pack `visual_style` layer and `illustrator` profile, the prompt skeleton (5.9) with its no-literals lint.

Specs: `image-profile.feature`: two publications never leak; precedence previewable with sources; a Story override cannot remove a constraint; agents cannot edit constraints; a profile edit makes a new version and old snapshots stay; no profile gives the warning and a skeleton-only plan.

What deploys: Backend: one optional field, one Lambda, two GraphQL fields. One site, then all.

Fulfils or changes: e4bdd096 (profile half).

Gherkin specs are required, and every PR merges to develop. Spending is only approved for step 6 (OpenAI gpt-image-2.5-flare, Machines on Machines trial; Batch where nobody waits). Style guidance is data, never code.
